feeds.title: The Fit Father Project Blog
feeds.description: The Fit Father Project is the leading health website for men over 40 and dads who want to lose weight, build muscle, and stay healthy for their families. Visit our popular blog for hundreds of free articles, videos, and programs.

feeds.title: Fit Dad Chris
feeds.description: Our goal is to get in shape, stay in shape, and motivate other dads to do the same. If you are looking to get in the best shape of your life and have some accountability and help to do it.

feeds.title: Super Fit Dad Blog
feeds.description: Trying to be the best person and Dad I can be whilst helping others along the way. Lifestyle optimisation is about re-engineering your workouts, diet, finances, career and wardrobe to get maximum results with minimum effort - leaving you plenty of time to be a better husband and father.

feeds.title: Reden Dionisio Blog
feeds.description: Currently on an Operation, helping Busy Dads burn weight, build muscle so they can spend more time with their loved ones! Helping Busy Dads burn fat, build muscle without spending hours in the gym so they can spend more with their families. Are you ready to join the mission?

feeds.title: Get Fit Old Man
feeds.description: The fitness journal of a middle-aged Dad in a never ending battle to get fit. Get Fit Old Man includes fitness tips, nutrition plans and fitness gadget reviews.

feeds.title: Lean Green Dad Blog
feeds.description: Cory Warren is a husband, vegan dad and podcast host who creates plant-based meal plans. His quick and easy vegan meals help make a plant-based diet for kids simple! Lean Green DAD, provides easy plant-based meals for anyone looking to fuel their plant-based family!

feeds.title: Dad Bod Health
feeds.description: Jason Priest, founder of Dad Bod Health has created a program for busy Dads that allows them to ditch the dad bod without giving up burgers and beer.
